scientific_integrity: A complete analytical proof is included. Finite computations are stated as diagnostics only. Classical product-normal density and Gaussian-to-chi moment formulas are acknowledged. No external/independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-column tensor Gaussian sketching with an orthogonal deterministic residual. Only fixed distributions and unconditional normalized coefficient error are analyzed. No claims for arbitrary multi-column systems, runtime improvement, repeated sampling, or floating-point behavior.
title: Sharp inverse-moment thresholds and logarithmic tails for two Gaussian tensor sketches
